title: Musk Asks Suppliers to Move at ‘Light Speed’ on New Chipmaking Plan
title_zh: 马斯克要求供应商以“光速”推进新的芯片制造计划
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Elon Musk’s lieutenants have reached out to chip industry suppliers including Applied Materials Inc., Tokyo Electron Ltd. and Lam Research Corp.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——埃隆·马斯克的副手已经与应用材料公司、东京电子有限公司和泛林研究公司等芯片行业供应商进行了接触。

title: Stock market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq steady after record high closes amid hopes for renewed Iran truce
title_zh: 今日股市：因伊朗重新休战的希望，标普 500 指数和纳斯达克指数收盘创下历史新高后持稳
summary: Optimism is growing for an extension of the US-Iran ceasefire, providing a tailwind for stocks.
summary_zh: 延长美伊停火协议的乐观情绪日益高涨，为股市带来利好。

title: D-Wave CEO says quantum computing is already past its ChatGPT moment
title_zh: D-Wave 首席执行官表示量子计算已经过了 ChatGPT 时刻
summary: Shares of the quantum firm have surged 200% over the last year as Wall Street begins to price in a pivot toward real-world commercial utility.
summary_zh: 随着华尔街开始考虑转向现实世界的商业公用事业，这家量子公司的股价去年飙升了 200%。

title: S&P 500 hits record high as US blockade disrupts Strait of Hormuz
title_zh: 美国封锁霍尔木兹海峡，标普 500 指数创历史新高
summary: The Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) and S&P 500 (^GSPC) keep the momentum going in Wednesday's session, the latter hitting its first intraday record high since January.
summary_zh: 纳斯达克综合指数 (^IXIC) 和标准普尔 500 指数 (^GSPC) 在周三交易中保持势头，后者创下自 1 月份以来的首次盘中历史新高。

title: Allbirds stock soars nearly 600% as the shoemaker rebrands as an AI company
title_zh: 鞋匠将品牌重塑为人工智能公司 Allbirds 股价飙升近 600%
summary: Allbirds is getting out of the sustainable sneaker business and into the AI business.
summary_zh: Allbirds 正在退出可持续运动鞋业务，进入人工智能业务。

title: BofA CEO calls economy 'resilient,' ASML stock falls post-earnings
title_zh: 美国银行首席执行官称经济“有弹性”，ASML 股价在财报公布后下跌
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Producer John Hyland tracks Wednesday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories. Bank of America (BAC) reported quarterly earnings results.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级制作人约翰·海兰德追踪周三走势最强劲的股票和最大的市场故事。美国银行（BAC）公布了季度盈利结果。

title: AI trade could be overdue for a rebound amid major stock rally
title_zh: 在股市大涨之际，人工智能交易可能早就该反弹了
summary: The major market indexes (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) remain in striking distance to new record highs after recent rallies have erased the losses seen since the start of the US-Iran war.
summary_zh: 主要市场指数（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）在最近的反弹抹去了自美伊战争开始以来的损失后，仍然距离新纪录高点不远。

title: Wall Street's biggest fear gauge is fading. That means investors may want to buy the dip: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 华尔街最大的恐惧指标正在消退。这意味着投资者可能想逢低买入：每日图表
summary: The CBOE Volatility Index surged above 30 in the early days of the Iran war — a zone often associated with acute market stress — and is now back to an 17-handle, below the 20 level that often marks elevated risk.
summary_zh: 芝加哥期权交易所波动率指数在伊朗战争初期飙升至 30 上方（该区域通常与严重的市场压力相关），目前已回到 17 水平，低于通常标志着风险上升的 20 水平。

title: Tax Day, bank earnings, US stocks near records: Today's top themes
title_zh: 纳税日、银行盈利、美国股市接近纪录：今日热门主题
summary: Yahoo Finance Head of News Myles Udland takes a closer look at the events that Wall Street is watching closely on Wednesday, including the national deadline for American taxpayers, earnings from major banks Morgan Stanley (MS) and Bank of America (BAC), and stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC...
summary_zh: 雅虎财经新闻主管迈尔斯·乌德兰 (Myles Udland) 仔细研究了周三华尔街密切关注的事件，包括美国纳税人的全国截止日期、主要银行摩根士丹利 (MS) 和美国银行 (BAC) 的收益以及股票 (^DJI、^IXIC...
